content: Jiazhon Giesan Kun
Ingiekude jiqien jiwon kun hhantulazhi nieniene taikui xianli. Ersa xien tujiladene kieliewo, "Ta Falisai kunni kunieghei xioxin gie. Hhelashi jiazhon giesan kun wo.
Jizide giesan shiqinlai ulie khizheghakui uwo. Niuighasanlai ulie mejieghakui uwo.
Ta beichazide kieliesan kielienlai kunla ghadane mindamin chenliene. Ta giedera chighinde kieliesei kunla gie jiere fugiede kieliene."
"Mini zhanlienla, bi tande kielieye, beyeni aladene pse yama gie dachen hhelase bu ayi.
Bi tande kiense ayikui mejieghaye, beyeni aladene dozoheide echighaku qienli bichen hhense ayi."
"Tawun bunzhui 2 mao baer huinela? Ingieliuzhe Huda hhelai nieda ulie matane.
Tai qiorun jieredu usunniliuzhe toulazhi agizho. Ta bu ayi, ta olon bunzhulase zhunyo wo."
"Bi pse tande kielieye, kien kunlai melie mini renjise Kunnikewonye Hudai qienxien melie hhei renjine.
Kien kunlai melie mini ulie renjise bi Hudai qienxien melie hhei ulie renjine.
Kunnikewonni fandui giezhi kieliese roulienema, Shenlinni hu kieliese ulie rouliene.
Kunla tai laizhi huitan, noyen, qienli bareichen kun shida echise ta matugie huida giekui, yan kieliekui munan bu gie.
Hhe shihou kuse ta yan kieliekuni Shenlin mejieghane."
Bayan Guazini Sumulasan
Ingiedene olon kunla dundase nie kun Ersade kieliewo, "Loushi, chi gaidemi kieliezhi jiachanyi made ghughazhi ogi gie."
Ersa kieliewo, "Chi ene kun, mini tande kien noyen danlaghazhi gieni ghughaghane?"
Ingie pse kieliewo, "Ta xioxin giezhi yanyanji tanxin giekulase gholodo. Kunni amin olon baerghala gonxi uwo."
Pse bilazhi kieliewo, "Nie bayan kunyi ghazhadeni osisan zhonjia gansan no wo.
Hhe sumulawo, 'Bi ene zhonjiani khala teine? Teiku oron uwo.'
Pse bi ene cankune cheidene pse fugiede nie gie, taran dunxilane teiye giezho.
Ingie goyadene made ijin sunjisan olon no wo. Jinien ijieliuzhe bara dane. Ede suibien ijiezhi ochizhi udu daose olune giezho.
Ingiese Huda hhende kieliewo, 'Chi ene ulie mejiechen kun! Ene xii chi fugu widase dunxilachii kiende feiliene?'"
Ersa kieliewo. "Jin goyadene boubeini sunjizhi Hudai miende bayan wichen kunshi man intui wo."
Munan Bu Gie
Ersa tujiladene kieliewo, "Ingiese bi tande kielieye, ta amindene oluzhi yan ijiene, musine giezhi munan bu gie.
Amin ijiekuse zhunyo wo, beye musikuse zhunyo wo.
Ta louwalani uzhe, hhela yama ese tareizho, ese ghurazho, ghuraku canku ye uwoma, Huda qiezhezho. Ta bunzhulase zhunyo uwonu?
Tani dunda kien zhughe chilakughala aminne niecha fududagha shidane?
Ta intughani ga shiqinyi gie dane, pseshiku shiqinde munan giezhi yangiene?
Ta baihe chizhe matugie osisei nie uzhe, hhela ulie khishilane, bosiye ulie giene. Bi tande kielieye, Sulumane honshan zui henni xienzide musisanla ene nie chizhede ulie kurune.
Ta goude xianxin ulie giechen kunla, banche jieredu osun enedu wine, maghashijie luzide teiliuzhe Huda dou ingiezhi dabalaghazho. Tai qingie ulie gienu?
Ta ijiezhi ochikude xiahua bu giezhi munan bu gie,
enelashi man duyani kunla xiahua giekuni wo. Tande enezighan chaisanlai Adatai mejiene.
Ta Hudai gojiai xiahua gie, ingiese enelai man tande ogine."
"Ta kun choghontu kunla, bu ayi. Tai Ada bayasuzhi asiman gojiani tande ogine.

Ta giededu dunxilane huizhi nanxin kunlade ghughazhi ogi. Goyadene oluzhi ulie qida oluku qienbaoni zhunbei giedene boubeini asiman jiere sunji. Hhende boubeila ulie widane, ghughei ghula dane, ghughei ijie dane.
Tai boubei khalashi zhughetaiye khala wo."
Ezhan Irekui Zhunbei Gie
"Ta pixiene pixiliezhi zhulane jienjidene goude zhunbei gie.
Eneshi nie ezhan ghurunse irekuni sagheisan hojila niekielien wo. Ezhan iredene wijienyi eghikure hhantu niewo.
Ezhan irekude zeixin giesan hojilade fuqi wine. Bi tande shuhua kielieye, Ezhan goya wilie gieku jienne musidene hojilani shire jiere soughazhi ushilane.
Hhe banyede iremu, giegherekude irekude hojila ingiezhi giesei uzhese hhe hojilade fuqi wine.
Ta enei mejie, giei ezhan ghughei yan xienzide irekui mejiese giedene ulie oroghane.
Taye goude zhunbei giendu, ta mejie dakude Kunnikewon irene."
Beduru kieliewo, "Ezhan, ene bilasan kielienni bijiende kieliewu, dajialade kieliewo?"
Ezhan kieliewo, "Qinse kienshi kekaotu jienzha giechen gonjia wo? Zhanguijini hhende giededu hojilai, ijiekulani man gonjighasan pushonu?
Zhanguiji irekude hoji ingiezhi giesei chanlase hhe hojide fuqi wine.
Bi tande shuhua kielieye, zhanguiji hhende caichanlane man gonjighane.
Hhe hoji zhughedene sumulazhi mini zhanguiji deigo ulie irene gie, kewon, oqin hojilai eghizhi ijiezhi jiu ochizhi sudose
hhe sumula daku udu, mejie daku shihoude zhanguijini iredene hhei sidasunyi qiuizhi kielien ese chenliesan kunlare hhantu faine.
Ene hoji ezhanni isini mejiewoma, zhunbei ese giewo. Zhanguijini kielien mutun ye ese giewo. Ingiese hheni gundude faikuni wo.
Zinie zhanguijini isini mejie dazhi gou ese giesan kunlai gongiende faine. Olon ogisan kunlase olon kerene, choghon ogisan kunlase choghon kerene."
Ersa Danxinraghane
"Bi zemin jiere khan teile irewo. Bi sumulase khan ghujighan sidera qiisejiu.
Made da nie chijia xili giekuni wine. Hhei onchen gietula made yali fugie no wo.
Ta sumulase bi zemin jiere pinnan deilazhi irewo giezhou? Uye, bi tande kielieye, bi tani fandui gieghale irewo.
Enedu khuinase nie giede tawun kun bise ghuran kun ghua kunghala fandui giene, ghua kun ghuran kunghala fandui giene.

Ada kewonghalane fandui giene, kewon adaghalane fandui giene, ana oqinghalane fandui giene, oqin anaghalane fandui giene, ghadunmekie konbiereighalane fandui giene, konbierei ghadunmekieghalane fandui giene."
Ersa pse olon kunlade kieliewo, "Ta xibangiede olien nie chanlase 'Ghura boune.' giezhi kieliene. Kieliese boune.
Nanbangiese kei bosise, 'Khalundane.' giezhi kieliese khalundane.
Ta ene jiazhon giesan kun, ta qienqi bienjikuni mejiene, ene shihouni fenji dane?"
"Ta yale alinie olusei fenji dane?
Chi noyenyi shida echikude mo jiere duitoughalane gouda. Pse hhe chii panjiku noyen shida lai echise panjiku noyen gunnande jiuise gunnan chii bafanzide khane.
Bi chade kielieye, chi 1 fen baerniliuzhe honjizhi ulie qindaghase bafanzise khizhe dane."
